removedComments.text: /* Synthetic standalone batch driver. No journal or data creation. */
/* RINIT: positional input validation. */
/* ORDMAIN validates the calendar date before opening a batch unit. */
/* RCTX: this entry is restricted to a dedicated batch job. */
/* RSTART: a pre-existing job commitment definition makes this fail.
Ownership is set only after this call succeeds. */
/* RCALL: main alone controls normal per-event transaction boundaries. */
/* RCLEAN: stop status may mean uncertain commit; never label it undone. */
/* RRETURN: processing completion is independent of external settlement. */

removedComments.text: * ORDMAIN - synthetic order processing. Static candidate.
* ABI 0001; all transaction boundaries belong to ORDMAIN.
* ENTRY - positional ABI; exceptions return to transaction owner.

* MBATCH - A checkpoint represents a committed input envelope
* Step 2; BR-27, BR-28, BR-29
* MRESET - Discard every prior event candidate before reading the next
* MINPUT - Read one complete immutable input envelope after the checkpoint
* Step 3; BR-01, BR-05, BR-27, BR-28
* MREADROWS - Reject the 101st detail instead of silently trimming it
* MCONTEXT - Keep business identity separate from transport processing
* identity
* MUNIT - Deduplicate content before current-state eligibility validation
* MCANON - Full canonical bytes are the idempotency comparison value
* Step 4; BR-01, BR-06, BR-07
* MDEDUP - Same key plus changed content preserves the original ledger
* Step 5; BR-06, BR-07, BR-28
* MENVELOPE - Validate new semantic payload and explicit processing day

* MORDER - Read the complete current order and enforce optimistic version

* MNEW - A new request cannot reuse an existing business order identity
* Step 8; BR-08
* MVALID - All order candidates were validated before the first write

* Step 10; BR-10, BR-19, BR-32

* Step 11; BR-03, BR-11, BR-12

* MCANCEL - Cancel unshipped quantity after validating every requested line
* Step 15; BR-09, BR-18, BR-19

* MSHIPPLAN - Build frozen monetary and warehouse candidates for every row
* Step 17; BR-14, BR-17, BR-23

* shipments
* Step 18; BR-12, BR-23

* unit

* Step 20; BR-20, BR-22, BR-32
* MRETBASE - Reconcile accepted returns with successful and pending
* adjustments
* Step 21; BR-20, BR-22, BR-24
* MRETAMT - Compute cumulative refund using original detail amount
* Step 22; BR-20, BR-22
* MRETAP - Restore original stock and create one adjustment per original
* shipment
* Step 23; BR-21, BR-22, BR-24
* MSETGET - Tie feedback to the immutable business and message identity
* Step 24; BR-24, BR-25, BR-32
* MSETSTATE - Decide allowed financial transition independently of delivery
* Step 25; BR-24, BR-25, BR-30
* MSETAP - Persist only an authorized state change; preserve physical facts
* Step 26; BR-24, BR-25, BR-32
* MDELIV - Dispatch transport acknowledgement by persisted outbox ownership
* Step 27; BR-24, BR-26, BR-32

* MRECANON - Recovery requires unchanged original canonical content
* MRETRY - Known no-effect failure can resend the same settlement identity
* Step 30; BR-24, BR-25, BR-31
* MVERIFY - Unknown outcomes require inquiry before another send
* MREPLY - Resend one receipt without any financial or stock operation
* Step 32; BR-26, BR-31
* MQUERY - Reconstruct latest evidence without re-executing the original
* event
* Step 33; BR-06, BR-26, BR-32

* order
* MQUERYRETURN - Read accepted returns without treating them as reopened
* demand

* MQUERYAUDIT - Stream matching history one framed audit record at a time

* Step 35; BR-06, BR-26, BR-32
* MNEXTMSG - Bound the deterministic per-input message ordinal
* MSENDREC - Persist one receipt page with complete framed payload

* MAPPENDAUD - Append one audit object; split oversized detail without

* MLEDGER - Close identities and batch checkpoint in the business
* transaction
* MCOMMIT - Stop on uncertain commit; never invent a compensating rejection
* MROLL - Known rollback starts a separate result-only transaction
* MFINISH - Mark input completion without pretending pending settlements

* Step 40; BR-27, BR-28
* MEVENTFIELDS - Event-specific required and forbidden semantic fields
* MIDENT - External identities cannot collide with internal delimiters
* MORDERFACTS - Validate the complete current snapshot before business
* decisions

* SSETHEAD - Frame named SETLHDPF fields as a complete evidence record
* PSETHEAD - Publish complete record metadata with explicit long-field

* MRECONCILE - Reconcile immutable physical history to current order
* counters
* MRECSHIPS - Check each shipment document and its original settlement link
* MRECRETQ - Accepted returns cannot exceed an immutable original shipment

* MRECRETURNS - Check accepted return documents without rewriting shipment
* history
* MRECSETTLES - Reconcile every settlement detail to its immutable physical

* MPRICEABI - Reconcile returned money candidates to the exact input basis

* MSETTLEABI - Validate the returned business document independently of

* MSETVIEWABI - Validate adjustment aggregation rows before permitting
* another return
* MREPLYABI - Validate a persisted message envelope without inferring
* business success
* MDAILYABI - Check the published snapshot identity and exact net equation
* MOPDETAIL - Emit transaction-specific evidence before the final summary
* receipt
* MOPORDER - Explain the accepted version, pricing snapshot and partial
* policy
* MOPFULFIL - Explain reservation or cancellation without implying a
* shipment
* MOPSHIP - Identify the physical shipment and its pending financial effect
* MOPRETURN - Identify restored stock and the independently pending
* adjustments
* MOPSETRES - Expose before and after financial state plus the feedback
* evidence
* MOPDELIVER - Report transport delivery separately from business
* settlement
* MOPRECOVER - Expose the explicitly authorized recovery and retained
* identities
* MOPQUERY - Identify the read-only projection target and its original
* request state
* MOPDAY - Show first-success-day totals and preserve the snapshot identity
* MOPREJECT - A result-only transaction does not certify a physical side
* effect
* MOPDUP - A repeated request returns its original outcome and current
* projection
